title: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Strategy Synthesis for Strategic Logics
title_zh: 面向策略逻辑的神经符号策略合成方法
abstract_en: Reasoning about what agents can achieve through strategic interaction is a core challenge in Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). Logics for strategic ability, such as ATL, provide rigorous methods, but their adoption is often hindered by the computational cost of strategy synthesis. We introduce a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) into the model-checking pipeline for MAS. The LLM acts as a strategy-generation oracle, proposing candidate strategies that are then formally validated by a standard MAS model checker. This generate-and-certify architecture uses LLM guidance to navigate large combinatorial strategy spaces while preserving formal soundness: generated strategies are accepted only when certified by the verifier. We instantiate the framework for bounded strategic reasoning in NatATL and introduce the first NatATL strategy-synthesis dataset, consisting of 4211 instances. Experiments with an open-weight Qwen3-32B model show that our certified pipeline achieves 92\% accuracy on strategy-synthesis outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文关注 Multi-Agent Systems（MAS）中智能体通过策略交互能够实现什么这一核心问题。ATL 等战略能力逻辑提供了严谨的形式化推理工具，但策略合成的高计算成本限制了其实际应用。论文提出一种神经符号框架，将 large language models（LLMs）接入 MAS model-checking 流水线：LLM 作为策略生成 oracle，提出候选策略，再由标准 MAS model checker 进行形式化验证。该“生成—认证”（generate-and-certify）架构利用 LLM 在大规模组合策略空间中进行引导搜索，同时保持形式化可靠性：只有通过验证器认证的策略才会被接受。作者将该框架实例化到 NatATL 的有界战略推理任务，并构建首个 NatATL 策略合成数据集，包含 4211 个实例。基于开源权重 Qwen3-32B 的实验显示，该认证式流水线在策略合成结果上达到 92% 准确率。
key_points_zh: 提出面向 Strategic Logics 的神经符号策略合成框架，将 LLM 与 MAS model checker 结合。
采用 generate-and-certify 架构：LLM 负责生成候选策略，形式化验证器只接受可证明正确的策略，从而保持 soundness。
将方法落地到 NatATL 的有界战略推理任务，缓解策略空间组合爆炸带来的搜索困难。
发布首个 NatATL strategy-synthesis dataset，包含 4211 个合成实例。
使用 open-weight Qwen3-32B 进行实验，认证式流水线在策略合成结果上达到 92% 准确率。

llm_assessment.comment: The generate-and-certify verifier pattern is relevant, but the work is mainly formal strategy synthesis rather than agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 生成并验证的模式具有一定相关性，但该工作主要面向形式化策略合成而非智能体框架演化。
